architecture.mechanism: In-cylinder pressure based 48V mild-hybrid starter-generator control strategy to minimize torque deviation
architecture.intervention: Apply the in-cylinder pressure based control algorithm via the vehicle's existing starter-generator or engine control module to stabilize combustion and eliminate misfires causing power loss and flashing check engine light, performed as a warranty-covered software calibration update
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of cylinder torque fluctuations and misfires, restoring full engine power and preventing the catalytic converter-damaging unburned fuel condition that triggers the flashing check engine light
architecture.falsification_test: Perform an on-board diagnostic scan and road test after applying the control update; if misfire counts remain above zero or the check engine light flashes under load, the intervention has failed
